ul.li: When a package adds a diagnostic code, an environment variable, an admin route or a DITA element, packages/cli/test/site.test.ts fails until the matching reference topic lists it.
The supported-elements table in topics/authoring/dita-subset.dita mirrors packages/dita/src/elements.ts, with the HTML each element renders as.
Keep release in opend.config.yaml equal to the packages' major and minor version.
Coming-soon pages carry feature="early-access". Replace the operator console's with real topics when it ships, and give each screen its own key, as the web editor's topics do.
The editor's variable table in topics/hosting/editor.dita mirrors the schema in packages/editor/src/config.ts; the site test checks it.
